notes: The closing whose day is come clause is aligned exactly as in EZK.21.25, independently derived from the same construction.
The verse note Or, punishment concerns עֲוֺן and does not change the alignment.

The two temporal בְּ prepositions take *while* under rule 52, and the supplied subject *they* stays with each infinitive because no suffix stands on either (rule 18's closing clause). The ASV makes רְשָׁעִים the head of the of-phrase and recasts חַלְלֵי as a relative clause, and the unit note records that construal.
